---

Our paper, [**"Correctness Comparison of ChatGPT-4, Gemini, Claude-3, and Copilot for Spatial Tasks"**](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/tgis.13233), was recognized by Wiley as one of the top 10 most-cited papers published in *Transactions in GIS* during 2024.

This study, a collaboration with [Henry Hochmair](https://flrec.ifas.ufl.edu/faculty/dr-henry-hochmair/) from UF Geomatics, assesses the reliability of large language models for geospatial tasks. It establishes foundational baselines for the ongoing research we are building at the **GATOR Lab**. 

Read the paper here: [Transactions in GIS](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/tgis.13233). 
You can also read the preprint version on [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02404).
